notes.note: Reviewed the generated privacy-policy delta and its source inventory. Coarse throughput is now expressly limited to conversations run in Station, excludes outside CLI use, includes declared disjoint caches, omits empty/unavailable values and discloses possible reset/correction undercount. The existing data/privacy links and qualification limits remain accurate. Generation is not publication, classification completeness or a deployed privacy assessment.

Traced the corrected Lite projection: only Station-run conversations, no read-only-attached/followed imports; cacheInclusivePromptTokens over recombined canonical event components; reported-input fallback with Codex inclusivity still unverified; empty/unavailable field omitted; usage read after reservation and outside the daily-state lock; accounting failure preserves the remaining ping. Reviewed receiver-first rollout and the unchanged shared fold reset/correction undercount (500k then 20k then 40k contributes 20k). Notice/catalog meaning, privacy generation and docs match. Red regressions reproduced; six repaired suites passed 203/203, and deleting runtime dailyUsage wiring produced one intended failure before exact restoration. Local/source/component evidence only; no deployment, live-provider completeness or native/release qualification.

Reviewed the changed daily-throughput read and disclosure delta against this document. Read-only-attached imports are excluded before their history is folded. No provider invocation, lifecycle writer, Project authority or recovery behavior changed. This is a delta source review, not live-provider, native or release qualification.
